Our Quality Commitment

At SARI Système, quality is not an option, it's our DNA. For over 20 years, we have been committed to providing medical equipment that meets the strictest international standards.

Our Certifications

  • ISO 13485 : Quality management system for medical devices
  • CE Medical : European compliance for all our equipment
  • FDA Approved : American certification for premium products
  • HDS : Certified Health Data Host

Our Quality Process

Each piece of equipment undergoes rigorous control in 5 steps:

  1. Selection of certified suppliers
  2. Testing in accredited laboratory
  3. Quality control upon receipt
  4. Installation by certified technicians
  5. Post-installation monitoring for 24 months
"Quality is the bridge between promise and customer satisfaction." — SARI Système Management
